# Contract: codebase-map

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: engineering. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Architecture, import and history analysis plus one real traced request or command, written up as MAP.md.

## Use it for
- "map this codebase"
- "I'm new to this repo"

## Not for
- review the API design (api-design-review)

## Accepted inputs
A local repository.

## Deliverables
MAP.md, deps graph (md/json/mermaid/svg), hotspots, trace.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- Git

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Ask one thing
2. Orient (15 minutes)
3. The data model is the backbone
4. Structure from imports
5. History: where the work and the risk are
6. Trace one real path by running it
7. Load-bearing vs dead
8. Write MAP.md

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Which path to trace

## Quality checks
- check_map.py validates every file:line reference
- claims marked ran or read

## Common failures
- Dynamic imports invisible to the graph
- Under ~30 commits history signals are weak

## Limitations
- Python tracer only; other languages need manual stack dumps

## Reproducible example
Run against the SumitCraft repo itself (evidence/codebase-map).
